result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I did not add tests for the new matches, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `build-gradle.js` cases are untested.

- **Generated HTML:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **Generated code:** the `<doc>` XML rule used `.*/[.]xml` and the `// Generated by` JavaScript rule used `.*/[.]js`. Those only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Build and deployment:** the Gradle JavaScript rule used `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` was already covered by a separate rule.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of these scopes. The generated-code rules also check content (`Generated by …`, `<meta name="generator" …>`, `<doc>`), and I left the content patterns as they were.
